summary: Executed backend+frontend regression for pre-event email workflow (dry-safe: no send-now/resend clicks). Backend pytest passed 15/15 for mapping, scheduling, cancellation, no-email notice/alert, idempotency, status/preview/regulation endpoints, and persisted pre-event fields. Mobile UI card and preview/regulation integrations verified on event detail.

critical.issue: Intermittent 500 in backend logs: KeyError 'password_hash' when user document lacks password_hash (e.g., account created via session auth path).

react_native_issues.issue: Console repeatedly reports: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' while rendering/interacting with pre-event email card.

action_items: Harden /api/auth/login against users without password_hash (return 401/clear error instead of 500).
Locate and fix raw text node rendered inside <View> on event detail screen to remove RN runtime error.
After fixes, re-run pre-event email UI smoke on mobile viewport and auth regression for password login vs session-auth accounts.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth path assumes every user has password_hash; session-auth/upserted user shape can violate this and crash login.
Runtime RN error indicates JSX structure issue (text outside <Text>) in event detail screen rendering path.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (targeted pre-event card checks passed; RN console error present)

rca_of_issue: Auth RCA: login handler directly indexes u['password_hash']; if user doc exists without this key, FastAPI raises KeyError => 500. Mitigation: guard missing hash and return 401/meaningful detail. RN RCA: runtime indicates stray raw text node rendered under View on event detail; inspect recent JSX blocks around pre-event card/actions and any conditional fragments for accidental plain string nodes.
